selectionPolicy.excludedIntervalReason: No intro/outro was excluded before selection; full video interval was treated as colony scene candidate.
selectionPolicy.strategy: temporal stratification over full usable video interval; 30 equal bins; initial center frame per bin
selectionPolicy.unusableFrameRule: Only technically unusable frames are skipped: unreadable/corrupt or strict black-frame check gray_mean < 2 and gray_std < 2.
